close_reason: Fixed: replaced is_none()+unwrap() with let-else in MemoryBackend::send_mdns
description: In MemoryBackend send_mdns: 'if dnt_address.is_none() { ...; continue; } let dnt_address = dnt_address.unwrap();' — clippy::option_if_let_chain and the let-else pattern (stabilized Rust 1.65) make .unwrap() after .is_none() unnecessary. Idiomatic: 'let Some(dnt_address) = dnt_address else { not_sent.insert(...); continue; };'. The .unwrap() is provably safe here but the pattern should not appear in code that students will read as the canonical backend example.
title: dnt_address.is_none() + .unwrap() pattern — should be let-else in MemoryBackend
